notes: REINFORCEMENT NOTES1. Read with the general arrangement drawings and the general notes (0900). Do not scale from this drawing.2. Concrete: columns C40/50.3. Reinforcement: high yield ribbed bars B500B to BS 4449, scheduled to BS 8666:2020. Bar schedules: 4501-01.4. Nominal cover c_nom to all reinforcement, links included (includes delta c_dev = 10): columns 40.5. Maximum aggregate size 20 mm.6. Bar notation: number, type and size, mark, centres, layer, e.g. 20H16-63-150 B1; centres and layer not given for beams and columns. Link zones (13@100): 13 links at 100 centres.7. Layers: T top, B bottom, N near face, F far face; 1 outer layer, 2 second layer (see the layer notation key). EF each face, EW each way, ES each side, STG staggered, ALT alternate, ABR alternate bar reversed, UB U-bars (SMDSC 4th ed. Appendix I).8. Laps and anchorages to the table in the general notes (0900) unless dimensioned; laps of adjacent bars staggered unless shown otherwise.9. Bars bent cold to BS 8666; none heated, welded or rebent on site without approval.10. Construction joints, holes and cast-in items only as shown or agreed.11. Reinforcement inspected before concreting; no bar substituted without approval.12. Fixing: Columns: starter bars fixed to a template before the base is cast, 75 mm kicker; links tied to every bar they restrain. Cages may be prefabricated.13. Typical details: TD C4 (MD C4) on drawing 4501 (after the SMDSC 4th ed. model details; confirm with design).
